description: This PHP source file defines the class 'HolidayMenuConfigurator', which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface to configure menu items for the Leave module in the OrangeHRM system. It mainly overrides the 'configure' method to set the current screen to 'viewHolidayList'.

classes.name: HolidayMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the holiday menu in the leave module, specifically overriding the screen to 'viewHolidayList'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default menu configuration to set the screen to 'viewHolidayList'.
